name: Idol Hakuraku Lesson
source:
Main character is a slightly devilish celebrity manager. He makes idols out of trouble girls with lots of complexes. There are three main disciplines - dancing, singing and acting - but the result greatly depends on the trust parameter nurtured in the girl.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/01/vn-of-month-august-2000-tsukihime.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公是一名有些恶劣的艺人经纪人。他把一群问题缠身、心结重重的女孩培养成偶像。训练主要分为舞蹈、歌唱和演技三项，但最终成果很大程度上取决于女孩逐渐建立起来的信赖度。

[来源：[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/01/vn-of-month-august-2000-tsukihime.html]vndbreview[/url]]
